shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f | head -n 100; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace; echo "---"; cat /workspace/opencode.json 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>&1

git log --oneline --all -n 20; echo "---"; git show HEAD --stat; echo "---"; git show HEAD --name-only --format="" | xargs -I{} ls -la {} 2>&1; echo "---"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "---"; cat .gitignore
grep -r "related" /workspace --include="*.md" 2>&1; echo "---"; ls /workspace/.next 2>&1 || echo "no .next"; echo "---"; grep -r "prefetch" $(npm root 2>&1 | head -1)/next/dist 2>&1 | head -n 50

find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -name "*.md" | xargs grep -l "prefetch" | head -5
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/ 2>&1
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link* 2>&1
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md 2>&1 | head -n 400

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md | head -n 500
echo "=== navigation ==="
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md | head -n 500

ls .next/server/app/product* 2>&1; ls .next -R 2>&1 | head -n 100
cat .next/server/app/product/page.js 2>&1 | head -n 200
cat .next/server/app/page.js 2>&1 | head -n 200

cat .next/server/app/product.html 2>&1 | head -n 100
echo "---RSC---"
cat .next/server/app/product.rsc 2>&1 | head -n 500
echo "---prefetch hints---"
cat .next/server/prefetch-hints.json 2>&1 | head -n 100

ls -R .next/server/app/product* 2>&1
cat .next/server/app/product/product.rsc 2>&1 | head -n 200
cat .next/server/app/index.rsc 2>&1 | head -n 200
echo "--- segments ---"
ls .next/server/app/product.segments/ 2>&1
cat .next/server/app/product.segments/* 2>&1 | head -n 500

cat ".next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc" 2>&1 | head -n 500
echo "---tree---"
cat ".next/server/app/product.segments/_tree.segment.rsc" 2>&1 | head -n 100
echo "---page segment---"
cat ".next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc" 2>&1 | head -n 500

npm run build 2>&1 >/dev/null && npm run start -- --port 3001 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 100
echo "--- product ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/product | head -n 100
echo "--- RSC prefetch? ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3001/product?_rsc=1" 2>&1 | head -n 500
echo "--- headers ---"
curl -i http://localhost:3001/product 2>&1 | head -n 50
ps aux | grep next
sleep 5; cat /tmp/next.log 2>&1 | head -n 100; echo "---try curl again---"; curl -s http://localhost:3001/ 2>&1 | head -n 20; curl -s http://localhost:3001/product 2>&1 | head -n 20
ps aux | grep "next start" | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill 2>&1; sleep 1; ps aux | grep next 2>&1 | head
pkill -f "next start" 2>&1; sleep 1; cat /tmp/next.log | tail -20; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
